query_text: Create a 2-day Kyoto itinerary for a couple visiting 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-19. Preferences: temples, food, calm walking routes, photography, budget JPY 40,000 excluding hotel. Must include day cards with times, places, estimated transport, costs, and action links. Candidate places: Fushimi Inari, Kiyomizu-dera, Nishiki Market, Gion, Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji, Kinkaku-ji, Philosopher Path. Keep it realistic with morning/afternoon/evening blocks.
